children: Blackstone CEO Steve Schwarzman plans to invest $40 billion in Japan over the next three years. According to Sina Finance, the investment focus includes real estate and acquisitions of companies in artificial intelligence and defense. Schwarzman said rising interest rates could cause Japan's economy to slow slightly, but he believes the slowdown will be temporary.

title: Blackstone CEO Steve Schwarzman Plans $40 Billion Investment in Japan Over Next Three Years
